item.title: DHS reveals Illegal alien behind fatal crash was given license by deep blue
item.description: An illegal alien allegedly responsible for a fatal crash that killed two in Oregon was given a commercial driver's license by California under Democratic Gov. Gavin Newsom, according to DHS.

item.title: US escalation with Maduro halts deportation flights to Venezuela
item.description: Venezuela halts deportation flights as Trump escalates military pressure on Maduro government, ending key cooperation between Washington and Caracas.

item.title: Nearly Half of US Truck Driving Schools Don't Comply With Federal Rules, Review
item.description: The Transportation Department said the accreditation of 3,000 CDL training schools has been revoked and another 4,500 schools have received a warning.

item.title: Trump's Targeting of Venezuela Is Necessary to Protect Americans: Naval Officer
item.description: Jonathan Hullihan, commander in the U.S. Navy's Judge Advocate General's Corps Reserves and attorney specializing in national security law, discussed the Venezuela situation and the president's responsibility to protect Americans.

item.title: Kash Patel: Drug Traffickers 'Scramble' After Chinese Fentanyl Supply Cutoff
item.description: Drug traffickers in South America are struggling to find fentanyl chemicals after the supply from China has dried up, FBI Director Kash Patel tells The Epoch Times.

item.title: Trump warns Honduras of 'hell to pay' if election count changes, presses
item.description: Trump threatens 'hell to pay' if Honduras alters election results, injecting himself into the country's tight presidential race amid vote counting.
